chapter: Family and early memories of Jelly
title: Grandmother's disapproval and the family names
summary: Her grandmother kept Jelly from the shady places; she gives the Péche, Monette and Mouton family names and talks about Shades of New Orleans on TV.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
